newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: RUGBY UNION-TRANSVAAL DEFEAT AUSTRALIANS.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-TRANSVAAL DEFEAT AUSTRALIANS.

text.p: In apalling conditions brought on by a lingering thunderstorm Transvaal held off a late surge to beat Australian Capital Territories (ACT) 44-36 on Sunday.

Both sides scored five tries as attack triumphed over a pair of porous defences at Ellis Park but Transvaal won thanks to full-back Gavin Johnson who kicked 19 points, potting eight out of nine attempts at goal.

There was almost nothing between the two sides in the first period. ACT centre Pat Howard responded to a fourth-minute try by Springbok back-row forward Ian Macdonald with a devastating angled run through a slipshod defence in the sixth.
ACT full-back Stephen Larkham ghosted through more poor tackles to score in the 16th minute and it was the signal for the floodgates to open at both ends.
Springboks Johan Roux and Japie Mulder touched down for the home side in the 26th and 32nd minutes, while Wallaby scrum-half George Gregan wriggled over for ACT in the 29th minute.
Johnson kicked his second penalty in injury time and Transvaal turned round 27-24 up.
The South African side never lost the advantage as Johnson stretched the lead with a 45th-minute penalty and left wing Joe Gillingham scored their fourth try on the hour.

Scrum-half Roux created the fifth with a brilliant lateral penalty kick in the 64th minute. Prop forward Balie Swart caught the ball on the right wing and fed fly-half Hennie le Roux who crashed over in the corner.
From 44-24 down ACT mounted a spirited recovery with tries from left wing Joe Roff and a second from Larkham.
Fly-half David Knox had a chance to earn a consolation point for his team for a loss within seven points but his 80th-minute penalty sailed tantalisingly wide.

Transvaal: Gavin Johnson; Wickus Venter, Japie Mulder (Jannie van der Walt, 66th minute), Christiaan Scholtz, Joe Gillingham; Hennie Le Roux, Johan Roux; Andre Vos, Ian Macdonald, Warren Brosnihan, Hannes Strydom (Bruce Thorne, 12), Kobus Wiese (Captain), Willie Enslin (Kapstock van Greuning, 50), Chris Rossouw, Balie Swart.

Australian Capital Territories: Stephen Larkham; Mitch Hardy, Adam Magro, Pat Howard (James Holbeck, 66), Joe Roff; David Knox, George Gregan; Troy Coker, Brett Robinson (Captain) (Troy Jaques, 62), Ipolito Fenukitau, David Giffin, John Langfod, Ewen McKenzie (Rod Moore, 41), Marco Caputo, Patricio Noriega.
